# walite v1.2.0

Release-candidate archives passed local installation and reboot acceptance on
MX Linux XFCE/amd64 and Apple Silicon macOS.
This is a focused notification and installation update, not a background service.

## Highlights

- WhatsApp mute-aware notifications for individual chats and groups, including
  permanent mutes and expiration of temporary mutes
- Native macOS notifications with the official Walite icon and click-to-chat:
  restore the exact minimized iTerm2 window/tab/session and open the originating
  conversation safely
- Linux XFCE and i3/Dunst notification actions with exact owning-window
  restoration and a dedicated 48×48 official notification icon
- Draft, pending-send and modal protection during notification chat activation
- Complete Linux/macOS archives for amd64 and arm64, SHA-256 checksums, and
  documented installation, upgrade and code-only rollback procedures

Privacy defaults remain unchanged: notifications On, previews Off. Notifications
only follow genuinely new accepted incoming live messages; cache loading,
HistorySync, paging, duplicate replay and reconnect history do not cause storms.
Walite must be running. There is no daemon, auto-launch or background service.

## Installation

Verify `SHA256SUMS` and unpack the matching archive into a new directory.
Linux includes `walite`, `walite-notification.png`, `README.md` and `LICENSE`;
keep executable and icon together. Optional `notify-send` supplies notifications,
with `wmctrl`, `xprop`, `gdbus`, X11 `WINDOWID` and daemon action support for clicks.

macOS includes the architecture-matched native **Walite Notifications.app** with
its official icon. Install it at `~/Applications/Walite Notifications.app`, keeping
the existing bundle ID. Stop the old helper and retain a verified non-`.app`
backup before replacement. No Homebrew or `terminal-notifier` is needed at runtime;
iTerm2 is required only for exact clickable session restoration. Other setups
retain ordinary `osascript` notifications. Follow README installation/upgrade
instructions. Existing linked sessions, SQLite cache and settings must be retained;
upgrading is not a reason to re-pair or reset data/permissions.

## Known limitations

- Linux restores a terminal window, not an individual tab. Use **Open** when
  the daemon offers it; notification expiration and body-click behavior depend
  on the desktop daemon. Saturated action slots retain ordinary notifications.
- macOS delivery/clicks require correct helper installation and notification/
  iTerm2 Automation permission. The helper is ad hoc signed, not Developer ID
  signed or notarized; permission continuity across updates is not guaranteed.
- Hands-on packaged-candidate acceptance covers MX Linux XFCE/amd64 and Apple
  Silicon macOS. Linux arm64, Intel macOS, revoked permissions and every
  simultaneous-instance or logout/helper-relaunch case remain unvalidated.
- Notification appearance/permissions belong to the desktop OS. Terminal-window
  close confirmation belongs to the terminal emulator; Walite cannot prompt
  after a destroyed terminal. Existing signal-driven shutdown remains unchanged.
- Full Status support, typing/presence, expired-media refresh, and daemon
  operation remain unimplemented. Unsupported special chats remain read-only.
- Animated WebP preview depends on the viewer; expired media may remain unavailable.

walite is unofficial and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by
WhatsApp or Meta.
